children.name: Krynickillus
children.description: Krynickillus — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Krynickillus dymczeviczii Kaleniczenko, 1851
children.description: Krynickillus dymczeviczii Kaleniczenko, 1851 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Krynickillus eichwaldii Kaleniczenko, 1851
children.description: Krynickillus eichwaldii Kaleniczenko, 1851 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.description: Krynickillus hoplites is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Krynickillus melanocephalus Kaleniczenko, 1851
children.description: Krynickillus melanocephalus Kaleniczenko, 1851 is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Krynickillus urbanskii
children.description:
External: Narrow-bodied; gray-black to black, lighter on sides; blue band along midline of dorsum; blackish head and neck; keel along 1/3 of dorsum; clear C-shaped groove in mantle; fine grooves in thin skin; cream sole; clear mucus (Wiktor 1983, 2000).

Internal: All ducts (oviduct, vas deferens, spermatheca duct) long and thin; cylindrical or club-shaped penis without stimulator or appendix; folds inside penis; fine penial retractor muscle, joining apex of penis beside the vas deferens; small, ovate spermatheca, with spermatheca+duct is 2x penis length; curving, thick tubular oviduct; no intestinal coecum (Wiktor 1983, 2000).

Differs from K. melanocephalus: slimmer body, finer wrinkles, darker back, lighter neck, much longer genital ducts. Differs from K. hoplites: very similar, but soft rather than hard structures in penis.

children.name: Krynickillus minutus
children.description: Krynickillus minutus is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Krynickillus mentonicus
children.description: Krynickillus mentonicus is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Krynickillus melanocephalus
children.description: Krynickillus melanocephalus is a species of air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial gastropod mollusc in the family Agriolimacidae.

children.name: Furcopenis
children.description: Furcopenis — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Furcopenis circularis Castillejo & Mascato, 1987
children.description: Furcopenis circularis Castillejo & Mascato, 1987 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Furcopenis darioi Castillejo & Wiktor, 1983
children.description:
External: Slug evenly chestnut brown; skin very thin; mucus colourless.

Internal: Penis small, with two accessory bodies joining penis in anterior penis section, roughly equalling penis in size; both accessory structures with cap-shaped granulated glands at their apical ends; smooth walls and a longitudinal fold in the accessory structures; penis retractor muscle three-forked, attaching to penis and both accessory bodies; no rectal caecum.

children.name: Furcopenis gallaeciensis Castillejo & Wiktor, 1983
children.description:
External: Slug dirty creamy, slightly darker on back, sometimes with some dark dots; mucus colourless.

Internal: Penial gland in the shape of 1-3 unforked processes; penis with one accessory organ, at least as long as penis, with a large granular gland at its end; conical process and longitudinal fold inside accessory organ; penis and accessory organ connected by numerous coiled ducts (different to Furcopenis circularis); penis retractor muscle forked, attaching to apical penis end and to the membrane enveloping the gland of the accessory body; penis without stimulator and with smooth interior; no rectal caecum.

children.name: Furcopenis geresiensis
children.description: Furcopenis geresiensis is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Furcopenis circularis
children.description: Furcopenis circularis is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Furcopenis darioi
children.description: Furcopenis darioi is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Furcopenis gallaeciensis
children.description: Furcopenis gallaeciensis is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras
children.description: Deroceras — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Agriolimax andrios Simroth, 1889
children.description: Agriolimax andrios Simroth, 1889 (Deroceras Andrios Simroth, 1889) is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Agriolimax buchar Simroth, 1910
children.description: Agriolimax buchar Simroth, 1910 (Deroceras Buchar Simroth, 1910) is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Agriolimax fuscus Simroth, 1904
children.description: Agriolimax fuscus Simroth, 1904 (Deroceras Fuscus Simroth, 1904) is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Agriolimax kaffanus Simroth, 1904
children.description: Agriolimax kaffanus Simroth, 1904 (Deroceras Kaffanus Simroth, 1904) is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Agriolimax maltzani Simroth, 1884
children.description: Agriolimax maltzani Simroth, 1884 (Deroceras Maltzani Simroth, 1884) is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras abessinicum
children.description:
External: Black to gray-blue body, sometimes with black spots on both body and mantle; light yellow sole (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Penis formed from oval parts with constrictions in between; tubular gland on apical side of penis above vas deferens; no papillae in penial gland; wide retractor muscle on apex of penis; conical stimulator in penis; no rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras adolphi Wiktor, 1998
children.description:
External: Cream-beige to white body, dark spots on body and particularly the mantle; dark marking around edge of pneumostome; often spots form reticulations in skin wrinkles; thick skin (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Penis irregular in shape; large, tapering penis gland, 1/2 penis length, on apex of penis; penis gland interior smooth-walled with a longitudinal fold; penial retractor muscle branched and off side of penis apex; conic stimulator in the middle of the penis; spermatheca wide with a short duct; minimal rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras aenigma A.B.Leonard, 1950
children.description: Deroceras aenigma A.B.Leonard, 1950 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras afer
children.description:
External: Dark brown body with dark spots on mantle; thick skin; possibly darkly pigmented reticulations in skin (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Rounded penis with a deep indent on one side; large papillate penial gland on apex of penis, with two branches each divided into two more branches; broad appendix on penis apex; penial retractor muscle with multiple branches, and attached to side of penis appendix and base of penis gland; vas deferens attached to penis apex under penis gland and retractor muscle branch; flat, wide penial stimulator with edges curled over in penis; minimal caecum on rectum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras agreste
children.description: Deroceras agreste is a species of air-breathing land slug in the family Agriolimacidae.

children.name: Deroceras altaicum
children.description:
External: Mantle 2/3 of body length; light yellow, gray cream, yellow-brown, to black body; dark spots on mantle; dark reticulations on tail, concentrated in skin grooves; narrow spindle-shaped body; pneumostome medial on mantle; light yellow sole; mucus clear, milky when perturbed (Chen & Gao 1989; Wiktor et al. 2000).

Internal: Penis variable in shape, with finger-like gland at apex; vas deferens attached at side of penis apex under gland; penis retractor muscle wide, attached at side of upper penis; long, folded stimulator inside penis; ovate spermatheca narrowing through duct; rectal caecum present (Wiktor 2000; Wiktor et al. 2000).

Similar to D. reticulatum but is smaller and has no groove in penis (Chen & Gao 1989). Similar to D. agreste and unclear whether different species, but D. agreste is larger-bodied with larger penis and different shape of stimulator and gland (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras altimirai van Regteren Altena, 1969
children.description:
External: Cream-yellow body darker on dorsum, and some individuals almost black; dark flecks on body, including on mantle and on edge of pneumostome; gray-cream sole, with dark flecks on edges; clear mucus, whitish when perturbed (but not as milky as D. reticulatum) (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Genitalia small relative to body size, in comparison to other Deroceras; penis oblong, divided in two parts, with upper penis pigmented in darker individuals; simple, small, hooked gland on apex of penis; vas deferens attached to penis apex under gland, and retractor muscle at apex; penial stimulator/sarcobelum conic, sometimes flat, with grooves; caecum on rectum present (Altena 1969; Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras astypalaeense Wiktor & Mylonas, 1992
children.description: Deroceras astypalaeense Wiktor & Mylonas, 1992 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras attemsi
children.description: Deroceras attemsi is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras bakurianum
children.description: Deroceras bakurianum is a species of air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Agriolimacidae.

children.name: Deroceras barceum
children.description:
External: Gray-cream to brownish body with tiny dark spots in skin grooves (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Rounded penis with glandular tissue on one side; cylindrical appendix on penis, and gland beside it; vas deferens and muscular retractor attached to center of penial gland; gland very large with three papillate branches from a single trunk, with longest branch about penis length; conical, striated stimulator in base of penis; small rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras bisacchianum Bodon, Boato & Fo.Giusti, 1982
children.description:
External: Cream body with dark brown, scattered spots; cream sole (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Long, club-shaped penis with wider, often pigmented apical end; gland with 3-8 branches on a trunk on side of penis apex; no stimulator in penis; striated inner walls of penis; ovate spermatheca; short rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000). .

children.name: Deroceras bistimulatum Wiktor, 2000
children.description:
External: Slender-bodied; (preserved:) cream-brown or gray-cream body, with slightly lighter sides; may have pigmented reticulations in the posterior mantle skin; mantle posterior edge at half point of body; thin skin with calcareous particles inside (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Longish, irregular penis with a narrowed middle; two small appendices on penis apex; a gland with a single trunk and two branches further dividing between the appendices; vas deferens attaches at the base of an appendix; penial retractor muscle attaches between the two appendices; two stimulators in penis, one fan-shaped with a long, sharp part and the smaller stimulator low and "husk"-like, and both stimulators striated on both sides; small rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000). .

children.name: Deroceras boeoticum Wiktor, 1984
children.description:
External: Cream body with darker back and mantle; fine concentrations of dark coloration on skin, especially mantle (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Penis with a bulging, ovate base and a narrow, shorter upper part; conical appendix off side of upper penis; gland with 5 branches separately attached to penis apex; penial retractor muscle forked, with one branch attaching to appendix and the other to the basal section; vas deferens attaches at base of penial appendix; very shallow rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

Similar to D. seriphium but larger, unmarked, smaller penial appendix, conical stimulator. Similar to D. pageti but D. pageti has vas deferens attaching to appendix, longer upper penis, two-branched penial gland (Wiktor 2000). .

children.name: Deroceras boettgeri
children.description: Deroceras boettgeri is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras bulgaricum Grossu, 1969
children.description: Deroceras bulgaricum Grossu, 1969 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras bureschi
children.description:
External: Dark brown body, often with large dark flecks (Wiktor 1983).

Internal: Irregularly-shaped penis with narrower apical section; swellings and usually a smooth digital process (greatly variable in size) on the penis apex; penial retractor muscle in two branches, with one end on apical end of penis and one on digital process; penis with internal fold; yellow hard plate on penial stimulator; little or no rectal caecum (Wiktor 1983, 2000).

Similar to D. laeve, but tail (behind mantle) is relatively wide and short (Wiktor 1983).

children.name: Deroceras caucasicum
children.description: Deroceras caucasicum is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras cazioti
children.description:
External: Brown-black body and mantle with no patterns; lighter sides; cream sole (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Penis curved in an S-shape, with a rounded basal part and a narrower apical part; penis with muscular, thick walls and some "silky, glittering" portions; vas deferens and muscular retractor attached at halfway point on side of penis; gland with multiple, smooth loops and covered by a membrane on penis apex (loops are just threads in juveniles); conical stimulator inside penis; no rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras chevallieri van Regteren Altena, 1973
children.description:
External: Cream body with black spots, forming reticulations on tail; keel also spotted (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Rounded penis with pigmented apex; penial gland is two branching tufts; vas deferens attached between penial glands on side of penis apex; retractor muscle strong and attached on penis near glands and vas deferens; tongue-shaped flat stimulator in penis; ovate spermatheca with a distinct, thin duct; long rectal caecum (De Winter 1986; Wiktor 2000).

Similar to juvenile D. reticulatum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras christae Rähle, 1998
children.description:
External: Preserved: gray-cream body; mantle with gray flecks, most in the middle; gray rhomboid reticulated pattern on dorsum, with fewer toward the sides; 3-part sole with darker middle section and light side sections.

Internal: Penis rounded and swollen; conic or rounded penis base containing a striped, flat conic sarcobelum/stimulator; apex of penis with a single long “feathered” or fern-like gland almost as long as penis; vas deferens attached near penial gland base; bifurcated retractor muscle attached at penis apex and base; ovate spermatheca with distinct duct; long rectal caecum (Rähle 1998; Wiktor 2000; Schütt 2010).

children.name: Deroceras chrysorroyatissense Rähle, 1984
children.description: Deroceras chrysorroyatissense Rähle, 1984 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras chrysorroyatissensis Rähle, 1984
children.description: Deroceras chrysorroyatissensis Rähle, 1984 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras cobanensis
children.description: Deroceras cobanensis is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras concrementosum
children.description:
External: Pale body with reddish dorsum, brownish anterior, and bluish posterior; spotted body, not foot (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Cylindrical penis with an enormous, hook-shaped appendix, with folds inside; penial appendix with three digital processes; retractor muscle attached on side of penis apex; no rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

May be similar to D. glandulosum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras corsicum
children.description: Deroceras corsicum is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras cycladicum Wiktor & Mylonas, 1981
children.description:
External: Cream body with black spots on mantle and tail, or occasionally completely blackish; dark pigments form reticulations in skin grooves (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Penis with a rounded basal section and a narrow upper section; small, often pigmented appendix on penis apex, with vas deferens attaching at appendix apex; retractor muscle attached at appendix base; penial gland is a pair of unbranched processes with a single base on penis apex; wide, fan-like stimulator in penis base; slight widening rather than caecum in rectum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras dallaii Fo.Giusti, 1970
children.description: Deroceras dallaii Fo.Giusti, 1970 is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras deckeni
children.description:
External: Very large slug; entirely black body (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Ovate penis; small penial gland with three branches on one trunk on apex of penis; retractor muscle attached near penis apex with vas deferens beneath; glandular tissue around penis; a strong fold inside penis; no rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

May be Deroceras afer (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras demirtense Rähle, 1998
children.description: Deroceras demirtense Rähle, 1998 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras demirtensis Rähle, 1998
children.description:
External: Red-brown body with dark brown spots on head, mantle, and pneumostome edge; grey pigments in tail grooves form reticulated pattern; mantle red-brown with small dense spots and darker than dorsum, and lighter around pneumostome; light brown head with small dark spots; cream sole (Rähle, 1998; Wiktor 2000; Schütt 2010).

Internal: Large S-shaped penis 1/3 body length; wide, folded stimulator in basal 1/3 of penis; 5 papillate glands with a single trunk on end of penis; vas deferens attached at base of glands; bifurcated retractor muscle, attached near base and at 1/3 distance from apex of penis; flat, finely striated stimulator in penis; ovate spermatheca with undifferentiated duct; long rectal caecum present (Rähle, 1998; Wiktor 2000; Schütt 2010).

children.name: Deroceras dewinteri Maassen, 2000
children.description:
External: Slug blackish without spots; skin thin, grooves hardly discernible; mantle almost 50 % of body length.

Internal: Penis blackish, oval with constriction in its central section; penial gland with two lobular protuberances and no papillae; posterior section of penis with lateral extension; retractor short and undivided, inserting laterally at penis; stimulator small with an acute tip; spermatheca large and black.

Externally like Deroceras oertzeni.

children.name: Deroceras ercinae de Winter, 1985
children.description:
External: Slug usually evenly coloured; sometimes there are some dark spots on the mantle.

Internal: Penis divided in two parts; posterior part with a small lateral pocket; penial gland like a finger with two rows of big papillae; vas deferens and retractor muscle attached at base of penial gland; stimulator conical; no caecum on rectum.

children.name: Deroceras famagustense Rähle, 1991
children.description: Deroceras famagustense Rähle, 1991 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras famagustensis Rähle, 1991
children.description: Deroceras famagustensis Rähle, 1991 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras gardullanum
children.description:
External: Whitish body to light gray-brown, some with spots on the mantle and the sides below the keel, with the spots forming a reticulated pattern in the skin wrinkles; darker dorsum (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Penis generally divided into upper and lower parts by a constriction; basal section of penis containing a bulge and with a glandular wall; apical section of penis narrower; penial gland consists of 4-6 thick, slightly papillate processes, variable in length, sometimes bifurcate, and sometimes with a common trunk; wide penial retractor muscle, with bifurcation sometimes visible; very large, flat stimulator with folding, grooves, and a conical tip in the penis basal section; ovate spermatheca with a long duct (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras gavdosense Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994
children.description: Deroceras gavdosense Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994 is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras gavdosensis Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994
children.description: Deroceras gavdosensis Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras glandulosum
children.description:
External: Brown or purplish-black-brown body; sometimes with dark spots on mantle and tail (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Long, cylindrical penis shaped like an "S" and narrowing into a bent appendix; two penial glands: one consisting of fine glandular threads in a ball with a thick shaft, located between appendix and penis, and the other of similar composition located between the penis and atrium; penis retractor muscle with one branch between penis and appendix and the other attaching into shaft of penis gland; thin vas deferens joined between penis and appendix; just grooves, no stimulator or folds in penis; ovate spermatheca with long, thin duct; no rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras golcheri van Regteren Altena, 1962
children.description:
External: Slugs grey to pinkish violet (preserved creamy brownish) with dense brown-black colour spots, on mantle irregularly scattered, elsewhere accumulated in aggregates, also more concentrated in skin grooves; sole evenly creamy.

Internal: Penis without appendix (sympatric D. panormitanum have one long appendix); no other significant differences with D. panormitanum.

Slugs larger than sympatrically occurring Deroceras panormitanum, colour also different.

children.name: Deroceras gorgonium Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994
children.description: Deroceras gorgonium Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras halieos de Winter & Butot, 1986
children.description:
External: Slug evenly dark grey, almost black, mantle length 10 mm. Sole laterally greyish, in the middle section dirty cream.

Internal: Penis of irregular shape, with a large lateral distension comprising stimulator and 2 curved appendices; on one of the appendices the penial gland is located, consisting of some 4-7 long processes without glandular papillae; stimulator elongatedly tongue-shaped or nearly semi-circular; caecum on rectum long.

children.name: Deroceras helicoidale Rähle, 1998
children.description: Deroceras helicoidale Rähle, 1998 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras heterura Pilsbry, 1944
children.description:
External: Narrow body; "umber"-colored dorsum and mantle; sharply truncated tail end; 3-part sole "cinnamon-buff" with darker side sections (Pilsbry 1948).

Internal: Long, cylindrical penis with a narrowed apex; one side wall of penis thicker than the other; retractor muscle attached to penis apex, with vas deferens attached laterally nearby; only fine fingerprint-like grooves in internal penis; short rectal caecum (Pilsbry 1948).

children.name: Deroceras hispaniense Castillejo & Wiktor, 1983
children.description: Deroceras hispaniense Castillejo & Wiktor, 1983 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras ikaria P.L.Reischütz, 1983
children.description: Deroceras ikaria P.L.Reischütz, 1983 is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras ilium
children.description:
External: Gray-pink body in life, gray-yellow to ochre when preserved; large dark red-brown spots on mantle and dorsum, excluding keel; sides light; head gray; sole light (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Penis rounded with a bulging basal part; narrower upper part of penis, separated from basal part by a constriction; short, twisted appendix on penis; penial gland "fleshy, thin-walled, and lanceolately narrowed structure" with a corrugated edge; vas deferens attached to side of basal penis section; short retractor muscle with three branches attached to penis (middle and base of appendix and middle of penis); thin, cone-shaped stimulator inside penis usually protruding into penial gland; shallow caecum on rectum (Wiktor 2000).

Like D. osseticum, but head and neck are gray rather than white and much smaller penial appendix (Wiktor 2000). .

children.name: Deroceras invadens Reise, Hutchinson, Schunack & Schlitt, 2011
children.description: Deroceras invadens is a species of air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Agriolimacidae.

children.name: Deroceras johannae de Winter & Butot, 1985
children.description:
External: Dorsum and mantle evenly dark grey; plate around pneumostome lighter; sides downwards gradually lighter; mantle 40 % of body length; sole creamy. Some slugs have slightly different colours.

Internal: Anterior part of penis distended, posterior part large, kidney-shaped, consisting of 2 diverticula of about equal size; penial gland with 6 unbranched processes united with their bases; stimulator flat, semicircular; rectal caecum approximately twice longer than wide.

children.name: Deroceras juranum Wüthrich, 1993
children.description: Deroceras juranum Wüthrich, 1993 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras kandaharensis van Regteren Altena, 1970
children.description: Deroceras kandaharensis van Regteren Altena, 1970 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras karnaniense Wiktor, 1984
children.description: Deroceras karnaniense Wiktor, 1984 is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras kasium Rähle, 1993
children.description:
External: Slug unusually small; ochre to pale grey; back and sides covered with dark brown spots in skin grooves, forming a reticulate pattern; mantle darker than the rest of the body, except a lighter plate around pneumostome; mantle evenly pigmented, with darker spotting at the edges, 40 % of body length; sole pale.

Internal: Very typical penis and appendix: penis very small, and non-constricted, appendix larger, hook-like bent, with two unilateral constrictions at the surface of the bulging part, subdividing the appendix into three sections; retractor insertion marking probably the border between penis and appendix; penial gland set apically on penis with 5-6 equally long and partly bifurcate processes; practically no rectal caecum.

Differs from other nearby Deroceras because of small size (Wiktor 2000). .

children.name: Deroceras keanense van Regteren Altena, 1973
children.description: Deroceras keanense van Regteren Altena, 1973 is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras klemmi Grossu, 1972
children.description: Deroceras klemmi Grossu, 1972 is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras kontanum
children.description:
External: Brownish pale body (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Ovate penis; two penial glands, one with two branches and two small knobs; vas deferens attached at base of penial gland; penial retractor undivided (Wiktor 2000). .

children.name: Deroceras korthionense de Winter & Butot, 1985
children.description: Deroceras korthionense de Winter & Butot, 1985 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras korthionensis De Winter & Butot, 1985
children.description:
External: Slug light brown with fine dark spots on mantle and dorsum, sometimes evenly light; mantle 40 % of body length.

Internal: Penis consists of 2 parts: the lower contains the stimulator, the apical part is cylindrical, with a conspicuous papilla at the outlet of the vas deferens; penial gland in the shape of 4-5 processes adjoining with bases; musculus retractor penis unbranched; stimulator small, conical; no rectal caecum (contrast to D. turcicum).

children.name: Deroceras koschanum
children.description:
External: Yellow-gray body; dark spotting (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Long, tubular penis without a penis gland; possible appendix connected at its middle; longitudinal fold in apex of penis; conical stimulator in penis base; no rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras kythirense Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994
children.description: Deroceras kythirense Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994 is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras kythirensis Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994
children.description:
External: Gray cream body with lots of dark spots, especially in skin grooves; some spots on also on pneumostome, few on head; cream sole (Wiktor et al. 1994).

Internal: Simple ovate penis with little/no medial constriction; no penial appendices; a single large penial gland with large papillae at penis apex; penial retractor muscle joins penis apex beside penial gland and vas deferens; short, conical penial stimulator with striated outside; sometimes pigmentation on upper penis and stimulator; little/no rectal caecum (Wiktor et al. 1994; Wiktor 2000).

Similar to D. famagustensis but the latter not spotted, no penial stimulator, and rectal caecum present (Wiktor et al. 1994).

children.name: Deroceras laeve
children.description: Deroceras laeve, the marsh slug (or meadow slug ), is a species of small air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Agriolimacidae.

children.name: Deroceras lasithionense Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994
children.description: Deroceras lasithionense Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras lasithionensis Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994
children.description: Deroceras lasithionensis Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras levisarcobelum de Winter, 1986
children.description:
External: Brown-yellow to orange body, and brown spots on mantle and dorsum, with dark mark above pneumostome (De Winter 1986).

Internal: Penis is one part (no medial constriction; penis has a distinct knob near the base; apex has two lobes including one with a simple apical gland; vas deferens along middle with insertion below retractor; retractor muscle at apex; blunt stimulator without grooves; large ovotestis; pinkish or grayish spermatheca; little or no rectal caecum (De Winter 1986; Wiktor 2000).

Very similar to D. altimirai, except that D. levisarcobelum has a small rectal caecum and a smooth, simple penial stimulator (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras limacoides
children.description:
External: Light yellow-gray body with a light streak along mid-dorsum; mantle with dark spots in the middle and a dark band on either side; sometimes dark stripe on either side of the keel; (Simroth 1904 in Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Long, irregular, cylindrical penis; hammer-shaped apical part of penis with two side pockets; penial gland large, club-shaped, and smooth; vas deferens attached at side of apex; retractor muscle attached on side by smaller apical pocket; flat, tongue-shaped stimulator in penis; no rectal caecum (Simroth 1904 in Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras lombricoides
children.description:
External: Slug brownish or reddish creamy to blackish; mantle and back darker, sometimes with dark pigment concentrations there; sole creamy; mucus colourless.

Internal: Penis composed of two parts: anterior part spherical and with glandular papillae at one wall, posterior part narrower and usually cylindrical; penial gland consists of 2-5 branches with papillae set on a common shaft; stimulator-like membraneous and U-formed structure present in anterior part of penis (can easily be damaged during preparation); no distinct rectal caecum, only a pocket-like enlargement.

children.name: Deroceras lothari Fo.Giusti, 1973
children.description:
External: Gray to brown cream body, sometimes with dark spots in skin grooves forming reticulations (Wiktor 1996).

Internal: Penis with a medial constriction; penial gland is a single bent branch with glandular papillae; large, flat conical penial stimulator; large rectal caecum (Wiktor 1996).

Similar to D. reticulatum and D. turcicum both externally and internally, but single, large penial gland and wide, flat stimulator of D. lothari are distinct; externally similar to D. rodnae (Wiktor 1996, 2000).

children.name: Deroceras maasseni Wiktor, 1996
children.description:
External: Black body with lighter sides and mantle edges; pale sole (Wiktor 1996).

Internal: Glandular wall on side of penis base; vas deferens, penial retractor muscle, and gland on penis apex; 3-4 branch penial gland, with small papillae; circular conical penial stimulator; small rectal caecum (Wiktor 1996).

children.name: Deroceras mahiz Pierce, 1992
children.description: Deroceras mahiz Pierce, 1992 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras malkini Wiktor, 1984
children.description: Deroceras malkini Wiktor, 1984 is a agriolimacidae species found in Europe region.

children.name: Deroceras melinum Wiktor & Mylonas, 1981
children.description:
External: Slug colour creamy, dark spots on the mantle; dorsum behind mantle and sides are covered with spots forming a reticulate pattern; no dark pigment on middle of dorsum and keel.

Internal: Penis elongated with different swellings, with a bent appendix; penial gland relatively thick, with papillae; stimulator narrow and flat, tongue-like (its one side sunk); rectal caecum like a shallow pocket.

children.name: Deroceras minoicum Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994
children.description: Deroceras minoicum Wiktor, Vardinoyannis & Mylonas, 1994 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras moldavicum
children.description: Deroceras moldavicum is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras monticola
children.description:
External: Blue-black dorsum; no keel; longish neck; 3-part, gray-blue sole (Yamaguchi & Habe 1955).

Internal: Little, thin, flat internal shell; top of penis bulbous, attached to 4-5 digital flagella, vas deferens, and retractor; penis tapers strongly toward atrium; oviduct long and thin; spermatheca has a long duct attached to atrium (Yamaguchi & Habe 1955).

children.name: Deroceras neuteboomi Forcart, 1972
children.description:
External: Slug light meat-coloured; mantle covered with dark grey spots; dorsum behind mantle with fine spots forming a reticulate pattern; no spots in the middle of dorsum; mantle length more than 50 % of body.

Internal: Albumin gland reaching anteriorly to mantle margin; penis elongated or pear-shaped; no appendages on penis; no lateral constriction on penis; retractor muscle inserted close to vas deferens outlet, slightly anteriorly from the posterior end of the penis; stimulator flat with wide base; spermatheca and its duct roughly equal to penis length; no caecum on rectum.

children.name: Deroceras nitidum
children.description:
External: Light brown to black body; usually dark spots mostly on mantle; lighter sides; creamy sole; clear mucus (Wiktor 2000).

Internal: Penis with bulging side of basal portion, glandular tissue on the bulge; narrower apical section of penis with a small bulge on one side and a large penial gland on the opposite side; penial gland with wide base, tapering upwards, with 2-4 branche, covered in papillae; vas deferens attached at side of apex; retractor muscle usually forked, with one attachment point at the penial gland base and the other on the apical side bulge; flat conical stimulator in penis; little or no rectal caecum (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras nyphoni de Winter & Butot, 1986
children.description:
External: Slug dirty cream or creamy brown, with diffuse dark spots; no light section in middle of dorsum; mantle length 45 % of body.

Internal: Penis elongated with broad appendix; penial gland consisting of up to 9 unbranched processes with papillae; penis retractor muscle bifurcated; stimulator cone-shaped with wide base; no typical caecum, only a slight pocket-like distension in rectum.

children.description: Deroceras occidentale is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras orduensis Wiktor, 2007
children.description: Deroceras orduensis Wiktor, 2007 is a agriolimacidae species found in its native region.

children.name: Deroceras osseticum
children.description:
External: Thick-bodied; yellow-brown to gray-cream body with an irregular smattering of dark brown to black spots, and lighter sides; unique for genus in having pattern composed of large dark spots on dorsum, excluding mid-dorsum and sides; mantle a bit less spotted and always with a large spot over the pneumostome; calcium carbonate particles in skin appear bright white; short pale keel on tail; cream sole; clear mucus (Wiktor 2000; Sysoev & Schileyko 2009; Schütt 2010).

Internal: Oval, asymmetric internal shell; penis thick and long, ~1/3 body length, curved in an S-shape; large appendix not much smaller than penis itself, usually bent, and contained by a membrane; longitudinal fold inside penis; penial gland a row of short processes in a line on the penis apex; vas deferens at base of penial gland; penial retractor muscle usually with three branches; stimulator of flat cone shape in penis; rectal caecum a slight pocket (Wiktor 2000; Schütt 2010).

Similar to D. ilium (Wiktor 2000).

children.name: Deroceras pageti Grossu, 1972
children.description:
External: Slug pinkish or grey and without spots (preserved dirty creamy to blackish); sides whitish; juveniles darker and sometimes with indistinct dark spots; mantle length 35-40 % of body.

Internal: Penis in two sections: posterior section shorter and narrower; appendix short and cone-shaped; penial gland apically connected with penis, very long, sometimes even longer than penis, composed of a long trunk and two even longer processes with papillae and short offshoots; penis retractor muscle unforked; stimulator conical; vas deferens opens on the top of the appendix; rectal caecum short. .

children.description: Deroceras panormitanum is a species of air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Agriolimacidae.

children.name: Deroceras parium Wiktor & Mylonas, 1981
children.description:
External: Slug dirty or brownish cream with numerous darker blurry spots, or evenly brown or blackish with diffuse and merged spots; lowest parts of sides lighter; posterior part of body behind mantle becoming thinner, last section with a distinct keel; sole creamy, in darkest slugs the lateral zones of the sole are dark.

Internal: Penis and penial gland look like one single elongated organ; penial gland with some papillae on the edges; vas deferens opens at base of penial gland; retractor muscle unforked; stimulator very large, filling almost the entire part of the spherical part of the penis, and completely flat; rectal caecum has the shape of a vestigial enlargement.
